doppel · seven public corpora

The ladder

The same interactive report, run over seven pinned public Go projects — ordered old-and-complex to new-and-narrow, from a decade of container engine down to one library written in a sitting.

Doppel's models are all corpus-relative: information content, df caps, role thresholds, habitat temperature and the concept vocabulary itself are learned from the corpus being analysed. So the interesting question is not whether it works but what it degrades into at one end of that range and what it drowns in at the other. Both ends are below.

Every corpus is pinned to a release tag, so each pair a report names can be opened in that exact tree and judged. The counts under each card are the production population — --tests exclude --generated exclude, the defaults — and the code-shape floor is not a setting but a measurement: what a random, unrelated pair scores in that corpus at the default one percent rate.
